verdict.rationale: The product exposes a backend REST API usable without a UI. OAuth client-credentials tokens support machine-to-machine auth, applicants and workflow runs can be created from a backend server, and results come back via webhook or polling. A sandbox environment exists for non-production use. However, the core capture step relies on end-user SDK or hosted-link interaction, and nothing documents running verifications end-to-end headlessly or in CI pipelines. Missing for 10: CLI or CI-specific tooling/docs, automated/test-mode document and selfie submission without a human, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI use.
